 Medicare Open Enrollment: Getting the most out of your health insurance
 Healthcare changes as you age. If you're over the age of 65, you are now eligible for Medicare, but it's not as straightforward as it sounds. Open Enrollment runs from October 15th through December 7th. Michael Masserant, of the Retirement Education Foundation, shares what you need to know before electing coverage or re-enrolling. For more visit, refedu.org.
